exec sp_executesql N'SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(7), O.ORDER_DATE, 126) AS PERIOD, SUBSTRING(''JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec'', (MONTH(O.ORDER_DATE) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) + '' '' + CAST(YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE) AS VARCHAR(4)) AS MONTH_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDERS, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_LINES L ON L.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN CAST(@FROM_DATE AS DATE) AND CAST(@TO_DATE AS DATE) GROUP BY CONVERT(CHAR(7), O.ORDER_DATE, 126), MONTH(O.ORDER_DATE), YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE) ORDER BY 1',N'@FROM_DATE datetime,@TO_DATE datetime',@FROM_DATE='2025-01-01 00:00:00',@TO_DATE='2025-12-31 00:00:00'
